# What EpiExposure does?

`Introduzir o usuário ao workflow básico: da exposição ao modelo.`

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# =========================================================
# SIMULACAO: 520 epidemias x 86 dias
# 1 severidade por epidemia (DLNM-style)
# =========================================================

set.seed(123)

# -----------------------------
# Dimensoes
# -----------------------------
n_epi  <- 520
n_days <- 86   # 0–85

# -----------------------------
# Estrutura base (long format)
# -----------------------------
sim_data <- expand.grid(
  epi_id = 1:n_epi,
  dpp    = 0:(n_days - 1)
)

sim_data <- sim_data[order(sim_data$epi_id, sim_data$dpp), ]

# -----------------------------
# Inicializar
# -----------------------------
sim_data$tmean <- NA
sim_data$rain  <- NA
sim_data$rh    <- NA

# vetor final de severidade (1 por epi)
y_epi <- numeric(n_epi)

# =========================================================
# LOOP POR EPIDEMIA
# =========================================================

for (i in 1:n_epi) {

  idx <- sim_data$epi_id == i
  t_seq <- 0:(n_days - 1)

  # -----------------------------
  # Clima
  # -----------------------------
  tmean <- 25 + 5*sin(2*pi*t_seq/85) + rnorm(n_days, 0, 1.5)
  rh    <- 70 + 10*sin(2*pi*t_seq/85 + 1) + rnorm(n_days, 0, 4)
  rain  <- rpois(n_days, lambda = 3)

  # -----------------------------
  # ESTRUTURA DE LAG (CHAVE)
  # -----------------------------

  # efeito temperatura: forte em lags 5–20
  w_temp <- dnorm(t_seq, mean = 12, sd = 6)

  temp_effect <- sum(
    dnorm(tmean, mean = 25, sd = 4) * w_temp
  )

  # efeito chuva: acumulado em lags 10–30
  w_rain <- dnorm(t_seq, mean = 20, sd = 8)

  rain_effect <- sum(rain * w_rain)

  # efeito umidade: mais difuso
  w_rh <- dnorm(t_seq, mean = 15, sd = 10)

  rh_effect <- sum((rh - 60)/40 * w_rh)

  # -----------------------------
  # COMBINACAO FINAL (linear predictor)
  # -----------------------------
  eta <- 
    0.6 * temp_effect +
    0.2 * rain_effect +
    0.2 * rh_effect

  # -----------------------------
  # Converter para proporção (logit)
  # -----------------------------
  y_val <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta/10 + rnorm(1, 0, 0.3)))

  # limitar
  y_val <- max(min(y_val, 0.95), 0.001)

  # -----------------------------
  # salvar
  # -----------------------------
  sim_data$tmean[idx] <- tmean
  sim_data$rain[idx]  <- rain
  sim_data$rh[idx]    <- rh

  y_epi[i] <- y_val
}

# =========================================================
# JUNTAR SEVERIDADE (1 por epi)
# =========================================================

y_df <- data.frame(
  epi_id = 1:n_epi,
  y = y_epi
)

sim_data <- merge(sim_data, y_df, by = "epi_id")

# ordenar novamente
sim_data <- sim_data[order(sim_data$epi_id, sim_data$dpp), ]

# =========================================================
# RESULTADO
# =========================================================

head(sim_data)

# checagem
table(table(sim_data$epi_id))   # deve dar 86 por epi
length(unique(sim_data$epi_id)) # 520 epidemias
```
```{r}
library(EpiExposure)
```

```{r}
sim_data
```


```{r}

sim_data = sim_data %>%
  group_by(epi_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    cum = cumsum(rain)
  )

sim_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(dpp,cum, group = epi_id))+
  geom_smooth(se = F)+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}


cb <- define_exposure(
  wx_long = sim_data,
  vars = c("cum"),
  lag_max = 85,
  df_var = 2,
  df_lag = 5
)

```


```{r}

# construir design matrix
dat <- build_design(
  wx_long = sim_data,
  cb_templates = cb,
  lag_max = 85
)

```


```{r}

# preparar resposta
dat <- prepare_response(dat, y_var = "y", family = "beta")

```


```{r}



# ajustar modelo
fit <- fit_epidlnm(
  dat = dat,
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  random_effect = "epi_id",
  epiexposure_spec = attr(cb, "spec")
)


t = predict(fit, newdata = dat, type = "response")


dat2 = dat
dat2$t = t


dat2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y,t))+
  geom_point()



sim_dataa = sim_data %>% 
  filter(epi_id <= 80)

best <- find_bestfit(
  epi_data = sim_dataa,
  response = "y",
  group = "epi_id",
  time = "dpp",
  vars = c("tmean", "rh"),
  lag_max = 85,
  df_var_grid = c(2),
  df_lag_grid = c(2),
  max_vars = 2,
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  verbose = TRUE
)

sim_data

ens_unweighted <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "unweighted",
  top_n = 10
)


ens_weighted <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "weighted",
  top_n = 10,
  weight_metric = "CCC",
  weight_transform = "softmax"
)


ens_best <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "hard_voting",
  top_n = 10
)


ens_stacked <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "stacked",
  top_n = 10,
  stacking_model = "ridge",
  lambda = 1e-4
)
```

t

```{r}


tt = summarise_effects(fit = fit, wx_long = sim_data,
                  scale = "daily", effect_measure = "percent", uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 100,
                  output = "samples")
tt %>% 
  filter(var == "cum") %>% 
  filter(lag <=40) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(value,effect, group = sample))+
   geom_smooth(method = "loess",
              se = FALSE,
              linewidth = 2, na.rm = T)+
  theme_bw()

tt %>% 
  filter(var == "cum") %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = value, fill = effect)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Δ (pp)") +
  labs(
    x = "Lag (days)",
    y = " Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))+
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = "reverse",
    breaks = c(0,10,20,30,40,50,60,70,80),
    limits = c(0,85),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(19, 34),
    breaks = seq(19, 35, by = 3),
    expand = c(0, 0))

median(sim_data$cum)
```

output = "samples"

```{r}
sim_temp <- simulate_exposure(
  lag_max = 85,
  mode = "pattern",
  pattern = "alternating_lags",
  alternating_values = c(25, 30),
  background = list(dist = "fixed", value = 0)
)

sim_rain <- simulate_exposure(
  lag_max = 85,
  mode = "pattern",
  pattern = "block_lags",
  block_lags = c(10, 30),
  fixed_value = 10,
  background = list(dist = "fixed", value = 0)
)

sim_humidity <- simulate_exposure(
  lag_max = 85,
  mode = "profile",
  background = list(dist = "normal", mean = 90, sd = 5)
)

```

```{r}
pred <- predict_outcome(
  fit = fit,
  profiles = list(
    tmean = sim_temp$profile,
    rain = sim_rain$profile,
    rh = sim_humidity$profile
  )
)

```
